def count_attacked_squares(R, C, r, c):
    """
    Counts the number of squares attacked by a queen at (r, c) on an R x C board.
    R: number of rows (40)
    C: number of columns (60)
    r, c: 1-indexed coordinates of the Queen
    """
    # 1. Row attacks (excluding own square)
    row_attacks = C - 1
    
    # 2. Column attacks (excluding own square)
    col_attacks = R - 1
    
    # 3. Diagonal (d1: r-c = const)
    # Top-Right to Bottom-Left movement from (r, c)
    # (r-k, c-k): k <= r-1, k <= c-1
    k_prime_max_1 = min(r - 1, c - 1)
    # Bottom-Right to Top-Left movement from (r, c)
    # (r+k, c+k): k <= R-r, k <= C-c
    k_max_1 = min(R - r, C - c)
    D1 = k_prime_max_1 + k_max_1
    
    # 4. Anti-Diagonal (d2: r+c = const)
    # Top-Left to Bottom-Right movement from (r, c)
    # (r-k, c+k): k <= r-1, k <= C-c
    k_prime_max_2 = min(r - 1, C - c)
    # Bottom-Left to Top-Right movement from (r, c)
    # (r+k, c-k): k <= R-r, k <= c-1
    k_max_2 = min(R - r, c - 1)
    D2 = k_prime_max_2 + k_max_2
    
    # Total attacked squares = Row + Col + D1 + D2 (no overlap besides Q itself)
    total_attacked = row_attacks + col_attacks + D1 + D2
    return total_attacked

# Board size
R = 40
C = 60

# Test cases:
# 1. Center-ish (r=20, c=30)
r_center, c_center = 20, 30
A_center = count_attacked_squares(R, C, r_center, c_center)

# 2. Corner (r=1, c=1)
r_corner, c_corner = 1, 1
A_corner = count_attacked_squares(R, C, r_corner, c_corner)

# 3. Edge (r=1, c=30)
r_edge, c_edge = 1, 30
A_edge = count_attacked_squares(R, C, r_edge, c_edge)

print(f"Board Size: {R}x{C}")
print("-" * 30)
print(f"Queen at ({r_center}, {c_center}) [Center-ish]: {A_center} squares attacked.")
